about:
Medical Device Innovation Corp. (MDIC) was established in 2011 in Irvine, California. The firm operates from an office on Morse Avenue and focuses on guiding medical device concepts through commercialization.

The company provides innovation management and product development consulting for the medical device sector. Its services span research and development, intellectual property assessment, design validation planning, regulatory filings (including 510(k), PMA, and De Novo pathways), clinical trial management, prototyping, FDA design control and quality system regulation compliance, manufacturing set-up, and financial analysis such as ROI modeling and cost-of-goods reduction.

MDIC serves medical device startups, established manufacturers, and entrepreneurial ventures seeking to bring new products to market. Clients engage the firm for ideation and discovery, user needs analysis, feasibility road-mapping, and supply chain establishment, as well as for specific regulatory and clinical support.

The firm emphasizes an integrated approach that combines strategy, project management, and regulatory expertise to accelerate ideas from concept to market, aiming to maximize clients' long-term profitability.
